plan.displacement_convention: Retain both root-normal dz and wind-normal -sin(alpha)*dx+cos(alpha)*dz from the model zero-flow baseline; processed experimental export does not resolve the axis choice.
plan.branch_limit: Convergence and symmetry do not establish static or dynamic stability.
plan.failure_policy: Retain failed requests and continue to the next independent cold case; no retries. Stop when batch budget expires.
plan.static_scope: All finite exported speed coordinates; high-speed measurements can be oscillatory. No stability calculation is performed.

stability_evidence.finding: At5deg a strain peak and frequency coalescence occur at48m/s, then the peak disappears as speed rises. The authors describe possible instability; they do not supply exact onset/recovery bounds.
At7deg strain/spectral growth indicates instability at40m/s. Large second-bending oscillations are visible at43m/s, prompting rapid manual speed reduction. Exported finite points end at41m/s.
This is Test2 with the floor mount and10g tip mass. Do not substitute Test1 force-balance stability, Pre-Pazy behavior, or later no-tip-mass flutter bounds.

source_scope.interpretation: A converged static solution is an equilibrium even in an oscillatory regime; it does not validate stability or the experimental mean of a limit cycle. No threshold is invented between source-indicated speeds. Report errors for all92points with these tags and preserve absolute twist errors near zero.

primary_aerodynamic_model.source: Riso/Cesnik DOI10.2514/1.C036869 author preprint, sectionIII.C pp9–13 and sectionIV.C p21
primary_aerodynamic_model.VLM: 36 spanwise by18 chordwise potential-flow panels; supplied filenames endingUVLM are this lifting-surface branch.
primary_aerodynamic_model.strip: 15 strips, flat plate, slope2*pi, aerodynamic centerc/4; W=1-exp(-tau*(1-sbar)), tau quadratic in speed at fixed rootangle. Tau is fitted to VLM tip displacement, not twist.
primary_aerodynamic_model.exclusions: UVLM/DLM neglect stall, viscosity and thickness; paper flags these as experimental limitations. No Re-dependent section polar/profile model is specified for the primary comparison.
primary_aerodynamic_model.consequence: Finite-wing load distribution and twist can differ even when bending agrees; no justification to tune our tip correction or add a fitted section moment.

limitations: Root angle is not local section angle; do not evaluate the whole wing at the listed rootangle.
Actual local speed, induced flow, twist and Reynolds number vary along the wing and with the sweep.
Missing viscous effects are a hypothesis, not a measured correction or permission to fit/interpolate a new law.
